notifications.title: Dashboard shows an old upload plan for any setting missing from the database
notifications.detail: apps/dashboard/src/lib/store.db.ts DEFAULT_SETTINGS still says Shorts at 07:07, 12:37 and 19:07 plus trend slots 16:07 and 22:07, 2 Shorts a day, 30-45 s, long videos Tue/Thu/Sat (2 a week, 300-900 s). The publisher (workers/lib/settings.ts) uses 12:37 and 19:07, no trend slots, 3 a day, 60-90 s, Saturday only, 1 a week. Only settings saved in the database are shown correctly, so the Overview target, Queue, Calendar and Settings page can show the old plan. Agents can't change this line: it names the upload-schedule settings, which are yours.
notifications.fix: 1. Open the dashboard's Settings page and compare it with what you run now (Shorts at 12:37 and 19:07, no trend slots, 3 a day, 60-90 s, long videos Saturday 20:07, 1 a week). 2. Change any value that differs and save: Save writes only changed values, so a value that already looks right but comes from the fallback needs a change and a change back. 3. Better: copy workers/lib/settings.ts DEFAULT_SETTINGS into apps/dashboard/src/lib/store.db.ts DEFAULT_SETTINGS (and the sample settings in store.sample.ts) so the two can't drift again.
